ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَكَم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا فَجَآءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَٰتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَآئِلُونَ

ayahOccurrences.text: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: قَآئِلُونَ is in the derivative form: قَائِل
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ق/ي/ل   q–y–l the noon, siesta, to take a midday nap, a midday resting place; to annul; to help out of difficulty; chief.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 11 times each in the Qur’an:
قَائِلُون qāʾilūn and مَقِيل maqıl.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
قَائِل qāʾil [act. part. of v. قَالَ qāla; imperf. يَقِيل yaqıl] one who rests or sleeps at midday

(7:4) فَجَاءَهَا بَأْسُنَا بَيَاتًا أَوْ هُمْ قَائِلُونَ so Our punishment came to it by night or while they slept in the afternoon. ‏

entries.label: قَائِل
entries.definitionHtml:
قَائِل qāʾil [act. part. of v. قَالَ qāla; imperf. يَقِيل yaqıl] one who rests or sleeps at midday

entries.label: مَقِيل
entries.definitionHtml:
مَقِيل maqıl [n. of place; v. n.] a place for repose, a place for a midday siesta; resting at midday, repose

(25:24) أَصْحَابُ الْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلا those in the Garden will have on that Day a better home and a fairer place to rest.
